reason: The README describes agent lifecycle primitives for sleeping, waking, event interruption, status reporting, and time context injection, making orchestration the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供可打断的睡眠唤醒、状态感知、整点报时和用户事件响应等生命周期原语。
summaries.en: Provides agent lifecycle primitives for interruptible sleep and wake-up, status awareness, hourly time updates, and immediate response to user events.

capabilities: Provides interruptible in-process sleep and automatic wake-up behavior
Reports current time, scheduled sleep, and recorded incident status
Injects hourly time updates into agent context
Cancels sleep timers when user events arrive
Records decision logs and incident data to configured paths
